The waw and the present existential negative fuse in the one word neither, which carries both the coordination and the negation (rule 35); the existential's frame is there is the construction's and joins that same unit, exactly as rule 50 keeps a dummy subject and copula with 'ayin and rule 30 admits a copula the construction hands to a fused expression. Headed on the negative, since rule 35 heads a Nor there and rule 50 heads an existential on the word carrying the negation. The fronted mayim standing between the two morphemes does not break the fusion, which is rule 35's explicit far side of rule 30's contiguity condition. The competing reading splits them, giving neither to the waw under rule 14 and is there any to 'ayin; I did not take it, because it leaves a negative existential holding a positive frame with no negation word at all and would head it on any, which rule 50's list of negation words excludes and which that rule's settled 28 occurrences never do.

The bare noun carries no determiner morpheme of its own, and the supplied any is the word English writes in that slot under a negation, so it joins the noun's unit and is never the head (rule 15). No kol stands on the noun, and the clause's negation is already written as the neither the waw and 'ayin are fused into, so nothing else licenses the determiner; a morpheme on which the ASV has already spent its word is not a home for a second one (rules 43 and 52).
Preposition before the infinitive construct takes the written to (rule 52).
Infinitive.

review_notes: Corrected at the existential clause: the waw and 'ayin are fused on neither, carrying the existential frame is there and headed on the negative, rather than split with 'ayin holding is there any and heading on any. Rule 50 heads an existential on its negation word and never on a supplied one, and the accepted split left a negative existential with no negation word at all.
The supplied any joins mayim's unit under rule 15: the noun is bare, no kol stands on it, and the clause's negation is realized in the neither, so nothing else licenses the determiner.

Each coordinated rectum of meqom takes its own written of under rules 19 and 25, and the two articles of ha-maqom ha-ra' ha-zzeh are unrepresented because the demonstrative pronoun realizes the phrase's single determiner (rule 41).
